description:
[RSSAmp] The person as a portable profile file (logicsrc.com/openprofile): identity block, Accounts, Topics, a Broadcast section (logicsrc.com/openbroadcast) for every show they publish, corrected by the person once they have claimed it. Returns the Markdown and the parsed sections. Pass either the author's slug or a feed URL; with a feed URL you get the profile of the feed's owner.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

feed.description: A feed URL; the owner of that feed is looked up.

slug.description: The author's slug in this directory.

name: rssamplifier_get_openprofile
title: RSSAmp: One author's OpenProfile.md
